description_ko: Android 오디오 출력 작업이 실제로 멈췄을 때, 통화/벨/피드백 재생 요청 또는 앱 복귀 시 출력 재시작을 한 번 요청한다. 이미 실행 중이거나 앱/청취자가 일시정지된 경우는 그대로 둔다.
preserved: Call APIs and call state rules
CallTower automatic incoming total 2 and >=60-second gap
Hand input, XR and package settings
OS device/volume and global listener pause/volume

voiceSource.reason: Existing dedicated AudioSource on same Call System object, no other reference found. Explicit wiring replaces fallback allocation, not a proven silence root cause.

audioTestClip.reason: Existing actual Elina answering WAV for already present method. Do not add new UI button automatically.

validation.scope: Actual four production C# files + Unity API doubles; no Unity Editor compilation, APK build, DSP or headset execution.

official_sources.claim: True means mobile output thread is running.
Starts Android/iOS output thread; has no effect when already running.
Stopped output freezes audio time/DSP but can retain isPlaying=true.

limitations: No device log proves the user headset output thread was stopped. This is a guarded recovery safeguard, not a confirmed root cause or proof of audible Quest playback.
Physical Quest volume, Bluetooth/output route, installed APK identity and actual sound remain hardware verification items.
